name: Stage Door Fresh Funnel Cake with Powdered Sugar
whyItWorks: Batter poured straight into a deep-fat fryer creates a web of crispy pastry that acts like a sponge for hot frying oil, topped with refined sugar. It frequently provokes acute dumping syndrome and bowel distress.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Extreme Grease Warning: Share a single forkful if in stable remission, or skip entirely in favor of a soft Mickey pretzel.
